user.title: Log in to Elli
user.description:
Elli's login page blocks automated logins, so you log in in your browser and paste the address Elli sends you back to.

1. Open your browser's developer tools (F12) on the **Console** tab, then open [the Elli login]({login_url}) in the same tab.
2. Log in. Elli then tries to open the Elli app, which fails in a desktop browser.
3. Copy the address that starts with `com.elli.ios.emsp://` from the console error (or from the browser's address bar) and paste it below.

The link works once and for a few minutes only. If anything goes wrong, a new link is shown.

reauth_confirm.title: Log in to Elli again
reauth_confirm.description: Elli no longer accepts the stored login. Open your browser's developer tools (F12) on the **Console** tab, open [the Elli login]({login_url}), log in, and paste the `com.elli.ios.emsp://` address from the console error below.

error.state_mismatch: This address belongs to an older login link. Use the new link below.
error.invalid_callback: That is not the Elli callback address. It starts with com.elli.ios.emsp:// and contains code= and state=.
error.invalid_auth: Elli did not accept the login. Try again with the new link below.
error.cannot_connect: Logged in, but the Elli API did not answer. Try again later.
error.unknown: Unexpected error, see the Home Assistant log.

abort.already_configured: This Elli account is already set up.
abort.wrong_account: You logged in with a different Elli account than the one this entry belongs to.

data_description.scan_interval: How often to ask the Elli cloud for new data. The cloud itself updates slowly, so shorter intervals rarely help.
